_comment: Per-route JS size budgets. 'warnKB' triggers a warning; 'maxKB' triggers a CI failure.
_notes: Budgets apply to the total first-load JS for a given route segment prefix.
Tighten these values gradually as you optimize splits and lazy-load heavy components.
Run 'pnpm run size:check' locally after any build to see current sizes.

Route code-splitting targets: each route's own chunks <50KB (warnKB) and the shared main bundle <100KB gzipped. 'shared-chunks' is measured in raw (uncompressed) bytes and includes the React/Next.js runtime, so its limits are not directly comparable to the gzipped target.

baseline._comment: Reference sizes (KB) for PR delta reporting. Update after intentional bundle changes. Recalibrated 2026-09-18 for the route-bundle-stats.json-based measurement (see check-bundle-size.js) — the prior values were calibrated against a webpack-era measurement check-bundle-size.js could no longer produce under Turbopack (Next.js 16's default `next build`), so every route reported as MISSING before this fix.
